name: التنبيهات
Toast
description: رسائل نجاح وخطأ ومعلومات، معلنة لقارئات الشاشة.
Success, error and informational feedback with accessible announcements.
useFor: Brief success, error or information feedback after an action.
avoidFor: The only presentation of a persistent form error or information requiring a decision.
rules: Wrap callers in ToastProvider inside SystemProvider; invoke useToast within that provider.
Supply translated provider label and closeLabel; toast() accepts ToastMessage.
At most three active entries are retained. Default duration is 5000 ms; hover/focus pauses expiry.
Events and business state belong to the application. No string-evaluated callbacks.

parts.message: title, optional description, tone and duration
